args.title: Saltmarsh returns pieces — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of "Retail returns logistics" (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns) and its companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
